signals.title: Tool error not recovered: patch_file on .moeb/README.md
signals.description: patch_file failed 3 times on .moeb/README.md with 'removed lines not in file' and 'removed lines not matching' errors despite read_file_range and grep_files confirming byte-identical content. Recovery required full file reconstruction via write_file.
signals.proposed_resolution: Investigate why patch_file removed-line matching fails on .moeb/README.md even when read_file_range reports identical content. Add byte-level diagnostic logging at the mismatch point.

signals.title: patch_file fails on long README table rows
signals.description: patch_file consistently fails to apply replacement diffs on long table rows in .moeb/README.md even when content is verified identical. Three consecutive attempts with different context configurations all failed. This is now the 3rd occurrence.
signals.proposed_resolution: Fix removed-line byte-level matching in patch_file.rs for long content lines. Add a regression test for patch_file with 500+ character table row content.

signals.title: spec.skill.md Phase 5 should use write_file instead of patch_file for README row registration
signals.description: Phase 5 of spec.skill.md instructs patch_file for README row insertion. Repeated patch_file failures force write_file fallback every time, costing 3 extra failed tool calls per run.
signals.proposed_resolution: Update Phase 5 of spec.skill.md to use read_file + write_file for .moeb/README.md updates, replacing the patch_file instruction.
